# Vendored zone: shadcn/ui

This folder holds the code that the [shadcn/ui](https://ui.shadcn.com) CLI generates. It is third-party code kept apart from the project's code (`docs/code_conventions.md`, "Vendored code").

- **Generated by**: `shadcn` CLI 4.22.1, style `new-york` (Tailwind CSS v4 registry), from `components.json` at the repository root.
- **Layout**: `ui/` holds the components, and `hooks/` holds any hook a component brings. This CLI version imports `cn()` from shadcn's `cn` package instead of generating `lib/utils.ts`, so `clsx` and `tailwind-merge` are not dependencies. The `utils` alias in `components.json` is kept because the CLI's schema requires it.
- **Packages the components need**: `cn`, `class-variance-authority`, `radix-ui` (Button's and Badge's `Slot`, and the Label, Separator, Switch, Checkbox, Tooltip, Sheet, Popover, DropdownMenu and Dialog primitives), `cmdk` (Command's searchable list) and `lucide-react` (NativeSelect's chevron, Sheet's and Dialog's close icon, Checkbox's check, DropdownMenu's check, circle and chevron, Command's search icon).

## Rules

- **Never edit by hand.** A file here changes only by regenerating it:

  ```sh
  npx shadcn@4.22.1 add <name> --overwrite
  ```

  Review the diff afterwards. To upgrade, run the same command with a newer CLI version on every component listed below, and update the version above.

- **One-way imports.** Code here never imports project code (`src/main/`, `src/lib/`, `src/App*`). `no-restricted-imports` in `.oxlintrc.json` enforces it: any `@/` path outside `@/vendor/`, and any relative path that leaves `src/vendor/`, fails the lint. Project code imports it through the `@/` alias with the file extension, for example `import { Button } from "@/vendor/shadcn/ui/button.tsx"`.
- **Wrap, don't modify.** When a component needs app behavior, a project component in `src/main/` wraps it.
- **No colors here.** The CLI writes its own `:root` / `.dark` color blocks into `src/main/app.css`. They are discarded: shadcn's variables are aliases of the theme tokens (`--ot-*`), defined in `app.css`.
- **Tooling.** The style lint rules (function style and names, explicit return types, `react/only-export-components`) are off here, the correctness rules still apply, and Prettier skips the folder, so files stay byte-identical to the CLI's output. TypeScript still checks them.

## Components

| Component    | File                   | Used by                                                |
| ------------ | ---------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------ |
| Button       | `ui/button.tsx`        | stage bar, stage dialogs, sidebar                      |
| Badge        | `ui/badge.tsx`         | stage bar (version, App and Mod labels), user catalog dialogs |
| Alert        | `ui/alert.tsx`         | load error, page load error                            |
| NativeSelect | `ui/native-select.tsx` | Theme control                                          |
| Card         | `ui/card.tsx`          | Settings page                                          |
| Switch       | `ui/switch.tsx`        | Settings page (section and media switches)             |
| Checkbox     | `ui/checkbox.tsx`      | site consent dialog, Settings page, import review      |
| Input        | `ui/input.tsx`         | "Add a mosaic" dialog                                  |
| Label        | `ui/label.tsx`         | Settings page, site consent dialog                     |
| Separator    | `ui/separator.tsx`     | sidebar (above the footer group), stage bar            |
| Tooltip      | `ui/tooltip.tsx`       | sidebar (collapsed rail, coming-soon items), stage bar |
| Sheet        | `ui/sheet.tsx`         | sidebar (drawer on narrow viewports)                   |
| Popover      | `ui/popover.tsx`       | stage bar                                              |
| DropdownMenu | `ui/dropdown-menu.tsx` | stage bar (More actions menu, folded capsule menu)     |
| Command      | `ui/command.tsx`       | stage bar (mod, collection and mosaic lists)           |
| Dialog       | `ui/dialog.tsx`        | none: added by `add command` for its `CommandDialog`   |
